name: Fortra-Originated partner discount band (Non_Orig_* percents)
what_it_tests: A Deal_Type__c='Fortra Originated' partner deal pulls its discount from the Non_Orig_* columns (typically lower tier than channel-originated)
proc_mechanism: Partner_Pricing_Model__c Non_Orig_Software_Pct__c / Non_Orig_Subscription_Pct__c etc.; Deal Origin picklist drives column set
expected_behavior: Net = List x (1 - Non_Orig_Discount%); lower discount than channel-originated (e.g. 12% vs 20%)
test_setup: Partner A (20% channel orig / 12% fortra orig), Deal_Type='Fortra Originated' -> 12%

run3_result.actual: Quote 0Q0WC0000039bwH0AQ (Deal_Type__c='Fortra Originated', PartnerAccount='AB Test Partner Account', PPM-00028, BoKS Perpetual). After Force-reprice on live V21 (isSuccess=true, no errors): BoKS Perpetual QLI (0QLWC000003eoAr4AI) Qty=1, ListPrice=355, NetUnitPrice=301.75 = 355 x 0.85 (15% channel column Software_Percent__c). Partner_Pricing_Source__c='System Calculated (Pre-Procedure, Percent Only)'. Deal_Type has ZERO effect: active prehook PartnerPricingPrehook V1 calls PartnerPricingService.getMarginForProductType(model, productType) with NO dealType argument and reads only Software_Percent__c. The Non_Orig routing exists only in the DORMANT PartnerPricingServiceV2.getMarginForProductType(model, productType, dealType). Additionally, ALL 30 PPM records have Non_Orig_Software_Pct__c=null (SOQL COUNT=0), so even if V2 were active the Non_Orig band would return 0%.

run3_result.defectStep: Not a V21 procedure step. Defect is in the Apex partner prehook layer that feeds PartnerDiscountPercent into V21: active processor = PartnerPricingPrehook V1 -> PartnerPricingService.getMarginForProductType(model, productType) is Deal_Type-blind (reads channel columns only). V21 'Partner Discount' / 'Resolve Partner Discount Percent' steps merely consume the pre-stamped PDP. Compounded by empty Non_Orig_* config on all 30 PPM rows.
